passages.title: Variables
passages.text: A variable is a named storage location in memory that holds a value. Variables can store numbers, text, or other data types depending on the programming language being used.

passages.title: Functions
passages.text: A function is a reusable block of code that performs a specific task. Functions accept inputs called parameters and can return an output value to the caller when the task is complete.

passages.title: Loops
passages.text: A loop repeats a block of code while a condition remains true. For loops iterate a set number of times while while loops continue until the condition becomes false.
